name: Settlement Details 234
definition: Details of settlement of a transaction.

HoldIndicator.name: Hold Indicator
HoldIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the transaction is on hold/blocked/frozen.

SecuritiesTransactionType.name: Securities Transaction Type
SecuritiesTransactionType.definition: Identifies the type of securities transaction.

SettlementTransactionCondition.name: Settlement Transaction Condition
SettlementTransactionCondition.definition: Conditions under which the order/trade is to be settled.

PartialSettlementIndicator.name: Partial Settlement Indicator
PartialSettlementIndicator.definition: Specifies whether partial settlement is allowed.

BeneficialOwnership.name: Beneficial Ownership
BeneficialOwnership.definition: Specifies whether there is change of beneficial ownership.

CashClearingSystem.name: Cash Clearing System
CashClearingSystem.definition: Specifies the category of cash clearing system, for example, cheque clearing.

MarketClientSide.name: Market Client Side
MarketClientSide.definition: Specifies if an instruction is for a market side or a client side transaction.

Registration.name: Registration
Registration.definition: Specifies whether registration should occur upon receipt.

RepurchaseType.name: Repurchase Type
RepurchaseType.definition: Specifies whether the rate is fixed, variable or a forfeit.

SecuritiesRTGS.name: Securities RTGS
SecuritiesRTGS.definition: Specifies whether the settlement transaction is to be settled through an RTGS or a non RTGS system.

StampDutyTaxBasis.name: Stamp Duty Tax Basis
StampDutyTaxBasis.definition: Specifies the stamp duty type or exemption reason applicable to the settlement transaction.

SettlementDetailsRule.definition: If SettlementDetails elements are used, then their conditions of use must be pre-agreed between account owner and account servicer.

CashClearingSystemRule.definition: The CashClearingSystem codes are to be used only by agents directly involved in the settlement process, such as local settlement agents, CSDs and central banks.
